name: Miki (Kagawa, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miki town emblem in red: an outlined fan of concentric arcs above a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Miki, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 28 January 2008; the emblem dates from 1 October 1955.

features.role: Miki town emblem — an outlined fan of concentric arcs above a stylised pointed device
